shared_tail.surface: أبي سلمة بن عبد الرحمن بن عوف

notes: Two isnads come before the same saying: the second («وحدثنا إسماعيل») is a second group, not a route of the first.
The first branch writes «الزهري» and the second «ابن شهاب» for the same meeting; both are written as the text writes them.
«أنه سمع حسان بن ثابت ... يستشهد أبا هريرة» puts Hassan in the scene only: he asks, he is not a link. Abu Hurayra's «نعم» is the words relayed, so he is the last link.
